scenes.text: How to sell *AI art on Etsy* under the *new rules*

scenes.title: Step 1: *pick a lane*
lines: Wall art, printable planners, party invites. One niche, one style.
Read Etsy's Oct 22, 2026 AI rules first: you need a real creative role, and you must disclose the AI.

scenes.title: Step 2: *make it in Canva Craft*
lines: Canva's Craft image model (free, Dream Lab tab) handles lettering, so posters with words finally work.
Prompt: 'Vintage botanical print, cream paper, sage green, 18 by 24, no text.' Then fix colors and layout yourself.

scenes.title: Step 3: *prove it's real*
lines: Print one copy. Shoot an unedited photo of it on a wall or desk. Etsy now requires one.
Add a line in the description: made with AI tools, finished by me.

scenes.title: Step 4: *list it right*
lines: Claude prompt: 'Write an Etsy title and 13 tags for this print; shopper language, no AI hype.'
Offer a digital download and a printed version. Downloads cost nothing to ship.

scenes.title: The *math*
lines: A $12 download: Etsy keeps 20 cents listing, 78 cents transaction, 61 cents processing. You keep about $10.40.
Ten sales a week is roughly $450 a month. Sales, not a guarantee.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Nobody buys on day one. Expect weeks of zero while listings index.
Rules change and Etsy can remove listings. Source: Etsy Seller Handbook, Oct 22, 2026.
